articles.title: Trophy Tracker: Lightning goalie Vasilevskiy early-season choice for Vezina

away.summary: The Lightning are riding a three-game winning streak after a slow start, with Nikita Kucherov leading a talented roster and Andrei Vasilevskiy expected to start in goal. They’ve snapped an 0-for-14 power-play drought and remain a model of consistency, though they’ve struggled in recent playoff first rounds. Vasilevskiy is the early-season Vezina favorite after a strong start to the season.

returning: : Bo Horvat (full participant in morning skate after concussion protocol from hit by Frank Nazar)
home.summary: The Islanders are coming off a 4-1 win over the Blackhawks, with Bo Horvat scoring twice and Ilya Sorokin carrying a shutout streak into the third period. They’re getting Horvat back after he exited Thursday’s game late due to a hit, and are hoping to put together a complete 60-minute effort against a physical Lightning team. Alexander Romanov remains out 6-8 months with a torn ACL, and Mathew Barzal continues to miss time with a knee issue.
